To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a simple Reinforcement learning model which considers only selling captures the decision making process of a subset of players; 2) the full RL model does not improve the fit significantly over the myopic RL model.

(1) A subset of players in a financial market online experiment can be modelled using Reinforcement Learning (2) Players are myopic, i.e. they do not consider long term consequences of their actions (3) The risk measure used in this paper is a good predictor of the behaviour of the players.
